provenance.purpose: Provider-free frozen candidate fixtures for Phase 4A; original archived reports remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Finalize working prototype for demonstration
tasks.deliverable: Working software prototype ready to demonstrate core functionality
tasks.completionCriteria: Prototype runs end-to-end and shows intended functionality without blocking errors

tasks.title: Record and submit demonstration video of working prototype
tasks.deliverable: Submitted demonstration video showing working prototype in operation
tasks.completionCriteria: Video captures working prototype in operation and submission is confirmed per requirement

mandatory-missing.explanation: Two tasks cover finalizing the demonstrable prototype building on reported React and prototype experience, and completing the missing mandatory demo video. No reviewed resources were supplied, so no resource IDs are attached.

tasks.title: Outline task tracker user journey
tasks.deliverable: One-page outline of the task tracker user journey from entry to completed task view.
tasks.completionCriteria: Outline lists each step, what the user does, and what is shown for entry, adding, completing, and viewing tasks.

tasks.title: Build static task list layout with HTML
tasks.deliverable: Static page markup for a task list with sample tasks and action controls.
tasks.completionCriteria: Page displays sample tasks with visible add control and complete control built with HTML structure.

tasks.title: Add client-side add and complete behavior without backend
tasks.deliverable: Client-side interaction for adding tasks and marking tasks complete in the browser.
tasks.completionCriteria: User can add a new task to the visible list and toggle a task between active and complete during a browser session without a backend service.

tasks.title: Prepare demonstration walkthrough script
tasks.deliverable: Short walkthrough script for demonstrating the user journey.
tasks.completionCriteria: Script covers each journey step in order and notes what to show and say for each step.

beginner-limited.explanation: Drafts support g-beginner for a simple task management prototype, using reported Basic HTML and a no-backend approach consistent with reported constraints including first hackathon context. No reviewed requirements or reviewed resources were supplied, so priorities use should/could and no resource IDs are attached.

tasks.title: Build core prototype flows in existing repository
tasks.deliverable: Working prototype screens implemented in the existing React repository following the existing wireframes
tasks.completionCriteria: Core screens render from the existing repository, navigation between them works, and the implementation follows the existing wireframes without recreating them

tasks.title: Refine prototype styling from existing design
tasks.deliverable: Refined CSS styling applied to existing prototype components
tasks.completionCriteria: Styles are applied consistently across prototype screens and changes are visible in the existing repository without restructuring the setup

tasks.title: Prepare presentation outline for prototype
tasks.deliverable: Presentation outline and draft explaining the prototype demo
tasks.completionCriteria: Outline covers prototype purpose, demo walkthrough based on existing wireframes and prototype, and next steps, and draft is ready to rehearse

existing-progress.explanation: Three drafts advance the prototype and presentation goal by reusing the completed wireframes and existing repository without repeating done or in-progress work, using reported React and CSS skills. No reviewed resources were available to attach and no reviewed requirements were listed for must-priority tasks.

tasks.title: Record open questions about participation and submission
tasks.deliverable: A list of open questions to clarify
tasks.completionCriteria: List distinguishes what is still unverified about participation conditions and submission expectations

tasks.title: Note areas of interest for general exploration
tasks.deliverable: A short written note on themes of interest
tasks.completionCriteria: Note identifies themes of interest without committing to a specific plan

unknown-facts.explanation: Tasks are limited to general exploration linked to the stated goal. No reviewed requirements or resources were available to ground specific preparation, and timing and participation conditions remain unverified, so drafts avoid specific plans and feasibility remains unknown.

tasks.title: Inspect and clean CSV dataset for chart use
tasks.deliverable: Cleaned CSV file plus short column summary for visualization use
tasks.completionCriteria: Dataset parses without errors, chart-bound columns are identified, and cleaning decisions are recorded.

tasks.title: Draft JavaScript chart prototype with prepared data
tasks.deliverable: Working draft JavaScript chart rendering the prepared data
tasks.completionCriteria: Draft chart renders in browser from cleaned dataset without data errors and code is saved for iteration.

tasks.title: Add interactive controls to visualization draft
tasks.deliverable: Updated prototype with interactive controls such as filtering or hover details
tasks.completionCriteria: Selected interactions respond correctly with test data and updated prototype is saved.

approved-resources.explanation: Drafts build on accepted CSV experience and reported JavaScript and Charting skills to support goal g-resources without assuming beginner status. CSV Data Preparation Notes is attached only to the data inspection task where its title and relevanceNote directly apply. Interview Preparation Guide is not attached because its relevanceNote states it is not relevant to visualization or CSV data. Estimates reflect task scope; feasibility is unknown with no deadline provided.

tasks.title: Define prototype scope and vertical slice
tasks.deliverable: One-page prototype scope with core user flow and vertical slice definition
tasks.completionCriteria: Written scope defines one core user journey, included data entities, and explicit out-of-scope items for the first slice

tasks.title: Implement backend REST API and persistence
tasks.deliverable: C# REST API with endpoints and persistent storage for core entities
tasks.completionCriteria: API serves CRUD operations for core entities with persisted data verified via API calls and handles validation errors

tasks.title: Build React TypeScript frontend shell
tasks.deliverable: React TypeScript app shell with routing and views for core screens
tasks.completionCriteria: App builds and navigates between core screens with typed components and API client structure in place

tasks.title: Connect frontend to backend end to end
tasks.deliverable: Integrated end-to-end working slice from UI through API to storage
tasks.completionCriteria: Demo flow creates and displays persisted data through the UI via the API without manual backend steps

tasks.title: Harden prototype for live demonstration
tasks.deliverable: Demo-ready prototype with seed data, error handling, and smoke-check notes
tasks.completionCriteria: Prototype runs from clean start with seed data and shows user-facing handling for API failures and empty states

experienced.explanation: Proposed as incremental full-stack slices building on reported React, TypeScript, C#, and REST API experience and prior shipped web apps, with no introductory tutorials per constraints. All tasks target the working prototype goal.
